f.title: Report serious ADRs from Bulgaria in E2B within 15 days to both the BDA and EudraVigilance
f.statement: All serious adverse drug reactions (ADRs) from the territory of Bulgaria should be reported in E2B format within 15 days, simultaneously to the Bulgarian Drug Agency (receiver ID-BDA) and to the EudraVigilance post-authorisation module (receiver ID-EVHUMAN).
f.clause: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
f.legal_basis: Regulation (EC) 726/2004 as amended by Regulation (EU) 1235/2010; Directive 2001/83/EC as amended by Directive 2010/84/EU; national transposition
f.applicability: Serious ADRs from Bulgaria; medicinal products authorised/registered in Bulgaria. Temporary arrangement: applies until 6 months after the technical functionality of the EMA EudraVigilance database is declared.
f.processes: Submission operations; E2B / transmission; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote:
All serious ADRs from the territory of Bulgaria should be reported in E2B format
       within 15 days simultaneously to the BDA (ID-BDA) and to the EudraVigilance,
       Postauthorisation module (ID-EVHUMAN).
rows.location: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
rows.review_note: Review: no change; level follows "should" although the letter calls these requirements. No deadline_rule: the letter does not state what starts the 15-day clock. Double-check: interim arrangement, obsolete since EudraVigilance centralised reporting; kept as historical baseline.

f.title: Report serious non-EEA ADRs in E2B within 15 days to EudraVigilance only
f.statement: All serious ADRs from outside the European Economic Area (EEA) should be reported in E2B within 15 days to the EudraVigilance post-authorisation module (ID-EVHUMAN) only, not to the BDA.
f.clause: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
f.applicability: Serious ADRs occurring outside the EEA. Temporary arrangement: applies until 6 months after the technical functionality of the EMA EudraVigilance database is declared.

rows.quote:
All serious ADRs outside the territory of the European Economic Area (EEA) should
       be reported in E2B within 15 days to the EudraVigilance, Postauthorisation module
       (ID-EVHUMAN) only.
rows.location: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
rows.review_note: Review: no change. No deadline_rule: clock start not stated. Double-check: interim arrangement.

f.title: Non-serious ADRs need not be reported to the BDA or EudraVigilance
f.statement: For all non-serious ADRs from Bulgaria, other EEA countries or non-EEA countries, reporting is still not required, either to the BDA or to EudraVigilance.
f.clause: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
f.applicability: Non-serious ADRs, any origin. Temporary arrangement: applies until 6 months after the technical functionality of the EMA EudraVigilance database is declared.

rows.quote:
For all non serious ADRs from the territory of Bulgaria, other EEA or non EEA
       countries – reporting is still not required either to BDA, or to the EudraVigilance.
rows.location: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: exemption recorded as Permitted.

f.title: Notify the BDA by e-mail before starting electronic ICSR transmission; no BDA testing needed
f.statement: The BDA does not require testing or a pilot phase for MAHs already in production with EMA, because the BDA is an EV WEBTrader user. MAHs intending to start electronic transmission shall initially notify the BDA by e-mail only.
f.clause: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
f.exceptions: No testing or pilot phase for MAHs already in production with EMA.

rows.quote:
BDA does not require performing testing or completing a pilot phase for MAHs, who
       are already in production with EMA, because BDA is an EV WEBTrader user. MAHs
       intending to start electronic transmission shall initially notify the BDA only by e-mail
rows.location: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
rows.review_note: Review: quote stopped before the e-mail address (checker rule). Double-check: "shall" = Mandatory.

f.title: On system failure, report by alternative means and tell the BDA of the failure
f.statement: In case of a system failure, the MAH should switch to alternative means of reporting (for example fax or e-mail) and should notify the BDA that there is a failure at the sender's site. The BDA will acknowledge receipt of these reports.
f.clause: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
f.applicability: Electronic ICSR transmission outage at the sender's site

rows.quote:
should be used and the BDA
       should be notified that there is a failure at the sender's site. The receipt of these reports
       will be acknowledged.
rows.location: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting
rows.review_note: Review: quote starts after the fax number and e-mail address (checker rejects e-mail addresses); the opening words "In case of a system failure switch to alternative means of reporting" precede the contact details in the same sentence. Double-check: modal "should be used" and "should be notified" in quote; OK.

f.title: After restoring electronic reporting, inform the BDA and submit the E2B version of backup reports
f.statement: When the problem is resolved and electronic reporting is restored, the BDA should be informed and the E2B electronic version of the report(s) sent by alternative means should be submitted to the BDA.
f.clause: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting

rows.quote:
If the problem is resolved and electronic reporting is restored,
       BDA should be informed and the E2B electronic version of the report should be
       submitted to BDA.
rows.location: Letter to all MAHs: temporary requirements for ICSR reporting

f.title: Submit all Bulgarian SUSARs to the BDA electronically in E2B format
f.statement: In accordance with Directive 2001/20/EC and the national Law on Medicinal Products in Human Medicine, sponsors of clinical trials are requested to submit all SUSARs relating to clinical trials ongoing in Bulgaria to the BDA; the BDA requests all sponsors of starting or ongoing trials to submit SUSARs electronically as reports in full compliance with the E2B standards agreed at ICH level and Community guidelines.
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA
f.legal_basis: Directive 2001/20/EC; Law on Medicinal Products in Human Medicine (SG 31/13.04.2007)
f.applicability: Clinical trials starting or ongoing in Bulgaria
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Submission operations; E2B / transmission

rows.quote:
The BDA requests all sponsors of clinical trials starting or ongoing to submit SUSARs
electronically in the form of a report in full compliance with the E2B standards agreed at the
level of ICH and Community guidelines.
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA
rows.review_note: Review: "requests" read as Recommended. Double-check: legal basis Directive 2001/20/EC since replaced by Regulation (EU) 536/2014; historical baseline.

f.title: Send SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria to both EVCTMPROD and the BDA (CTBDAP)
f.statement: Sponsors should submit SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria electronically both to the EudraVigilance Clinical Trial Module (message receiver identifier EVCTMPROD) and to the BDA (message receiver identifier CTBDAP).
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reporting rules
f.applicability: SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria; all clinical trials ongoing in Bulgaria
f.systems: EudraVigilance Clinical Trial Module; EVCTMPROD; CTBDAP

rows.quote:
Sponsors of clinical trials should submit electronically SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria
       to both the EudraVigilance Clinical Trial Module with the message receiver identifier
       EVCTMPROD and to the BDA with the message receiver identifier CTBDAP.
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reporting rules

f.title: Send SUSARs occurring outside Bulgaria only to EVCTMPROD; the BDA does not want foreign SUSARs
f.statement: Sponsors of trials conducted in Bulgaria should report SUSARs occurring outside Bulgaria directly to the EudraVigilance Clinical Trial Module (EVCTMPROD). The BDA does not wish to receive SUSARs of foreign origin, even if the same study or a study with the same investigational medicinal product is conducted in Bulgaria; submitting such SUSARs to EVCTM fulfils the reporting obligation.
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reporting rules
f.applicability: SUSARs occurring outside Bulgaria in trials conducted in Bulgaria

rows.quote:
Sponsors of clinical trial conducted in Bulgaria should report SUSARs occurring
       outside Bulgaria directly to the EudraVigilance Clinical Trial Module with the
       message receiver identifier EVCTMPROD. The BDA does not wish to receive
       SUSARs of foreign origin even if the same study is conducted in Bulgaria and/or if a
       study with the same investigational medicinal product is conducted in Bulgaria.
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reporting rules
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: the "obligations considered fulfilled" sentence is paraphrased in the statement but not in the quote; OK as context.

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs in Bulgaria to the BDA within 7 days
f.statement: Any SUSAR that occurred in the course of a clinical trial in Bulgaria and resulted in death or was life-threatening should be submitted to the BDA (CTBDAP) within 7 days at the latest of receiving the information about it.
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reports of SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria

rows.deadline: 7 days at the latest from receipt of the information
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reports of SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria
rows.review_note: Review: level follows the lead-in "should be submitted". Double-check: OK.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Fatal or life-threatening SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria

f.title: Send follow-up on fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 8 days of the initial notification
f.statement: Additional information on fatal or life-threatening SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria should be submitted to the BDA within 8 days of the date on which the initial notification was sent.
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reports of SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up; Submission operations

rows.deadline: Within 8 days of the date the initial notification was sent
rows.quote:
additional information about the above mentioned cases within 8 days of the date on
       which a notification was sent;
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reports of SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria

deadline_rule.clock_start:
the date on
       which a notification was sent
deadline_rule.applies_to: Follow-up of fatal or life-threatening SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria

f.title: Report other SUSARs in Bulgaria to the BDA within 15 days
f.statement: All other SUSARs occurring in the course of a clinical trial in Bulgaria (not fatal or life-threatening) should be submitted to the BDA within 15 days at the latest from receiving the information about their occurrence.
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reports of SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria

rows.deadline: 15 days at the latest from receipt of the information
rows.quote:
all other suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions other than those resulted in
       death or proven to be life-threatening that have occurred in the course of the clinical
       trial, 15 days at the latest from receiving the information about their occurrence.
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA: Reports of SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria

deadline_rule.clock_start: receiving the information about their occurrence
deadline_rule.applies_to: SUSARs occurring in Bulgaria other than fatal or life-threatening

f.title: Follow the CT-3 detailed guidance for SUSAR reporting procedures
f.statement: For detailed reporting procedures, sponsors should follow the Detailed guidance on the collection, verification and presentation of adverse event/reaction reports arising from clinical trials on medicinal products for human use (CT-3) (2011/C 172/01).
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA

rows.quote:
For detailed reporting procedures, sponsors should follow the Detailed guidance on the
collection, verification and presentation of adverse event/reaction reports arising from clinical
trials on medicinal products for human use
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: CT-3 later superseded under Regulation (EU) 536/2014.

f.title: No additional BDA tests for sponsors already in production with EVCTM
f.statement: The BDA does not require sponsors already in production with the EudraVigilance Clinical Trial Module to perform additional tests for electronic transmission of SUSARs to CTBDAP.
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA

rows.quote:
The BDA does not require sponsors who are already in production with the EudraVigilance
Clinical Trial Module to perform additional tests for the electronic transmission of SUSARs
to the message receiver identifier CTBDAP.
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA
rows.review_note: Review: exemption recorded as Permitted. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Sponsors not yet reporting electronically: prepare per EudraVigilance rules, testing with EMA only
f.statement: Sponsors of clinical trials not yet reporting electronically should prepare for electronic submission following the EudraVigilance reporting rules and procedures, including testing with the EMA only.
f.clause: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA

rows.quote:
Sponsors of clinical trials which are not yet starting electronic reporting should prepare for
electronic submission following the rules and procedures for reporting to EudraVigilance,
including testing with the EMA only.
rows.location: Electronic Reporting of SUSARs to the BDA
